{
  "name": "model-fit",
  "version": "0.8.2",
  "description": "After each ask you type, says what it looked like it needed and what it cost; after a simple or routine ask on a bigger model or effort than it needed, what Haiku, Sonnet or a lower effort would have cost; warns when an ask runs on too small a model or a complex one at low effort; says when the context has grown expensive and how to shrink it; ships /model-fit:baton, a handoff note for a fresh session. Optional Jev shadow labels for comparison.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt cache lifetime",
      "description": "auto: worked out from your settings and environment (an hour on a subscription, five minutes with an API key or a cloud provider). Set 5m when a subscription has run into usage credits, which model-fit cannot see.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "5m",
        "1h"
      ],
      "default": "auto",
      "sensitive": false,
      "required": false
    },
    "jevShadow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev shadow labels",
      "description": "on: Jev labels each ask beside Haiku and /fit compares them. Haiku still drives the advice. Sends the ask and the end of the last reply to TypeSafe.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ],
      "default": "off",
      "sensitive": false,
      "required": false
    },
    "jevModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev model",
      "description": "Pinned so the shadow comparison stays on one model. jev-1.14.0 is newer; jev-latest follows whatever TypeSafe points it at.",
      "options": [
        "jev-1.13.0",
        "jev-1.14.0",
        "jev-latest"
      ],
      "default": "jev-1.13.0",
      "sensitive": false,
      "required": false
    },
    "typesafeApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key",
      "description": "Key for Jev shadow labels. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    }
  }
}
